description: bits-ui's Switch compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified switch and label wrappers and the switch demo, and a small switch bound to the app (bind:checked, disabled, onCheckedChange, a name and so a hidden input). Toggled by clicks on the switch and on its label, by Space and Enter on the focused switch (bits-ui's keydown handler toggles and cancels the key), from outside through the bound value; disabled, it ignores clicks and keys. The thumb's translate transition and the track's colour transition are sampled while they run (pixel regions) and once settled

knownGaps.geometry: Blitz centres the content of buttons with an author display: flex (its UA sheet gives buttons justify-content: center); Chromium starts it, so the thumb (no justify-content in the switch track) sits 5-7px further right natively (docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, buttons with an author display; a fork patch)
knownGaps.pixels: The same thumb offset (docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, buttons with an author display)
